program.name: Short Variety
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: About twenty minutes, never the same twice: a quick circuit, EMOM, AMRAP or Tabata every day.
program.about: Short sessions that never repeat. Each day deals one of fifteen kinds of training, strength, cardio and core, in a timed format: a circuit, an EMOM, an AMRAP or a Tabata. Fifteen to twenty-two minutes, sixty different days, and never the same kind two days running. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
